scope: expansion-0156 through expansion-0160, 80 page illustrations plus 5 covers

visualReview.coverage: Read all five final text-ready manuscripts, all page scene notes, character specifications and editorial-004-older.md before drawing. Viewed all 85 first-draft frames in five contact sheets and all five revised sheets. Enlarged 0156 p01/p13/p14/p16; 0157 p06/p11/p12/p15; 0158 p02/p08/p14/p16; 0159 p01/p02/p11/p12/p13/p16; 0160 p04/p09/p11/p13/p14/p15/p16. After corrections, viewed every final contact sheet again and re-enlarged changed fossil, tucked-tail, chess-arm/bag/shoulder, mailbox and final garden details.
corrections: 0156: moved both half-fossils to complementary cut edges; paired paper rubbings now share one continuous fan outline and mineral line, with three bends only on the original half. The two stones remain separate. Brush touches the exposed stone while the comparison tracing is held clear in the other hand. First butterfly is a mistaken drawing only; no fossil species is declared. Three wrong candidate stones, ledger, empty shelf, autonomous slab turn, separate mailed copy and retained display remain visible.

0157: Tao has light-gray shirt sleeves and round glasses; hand-signal pose has an open humming mouth. The pot receives a voice line and only a short loop. Failed handoff leaves gaps around the stopped fish; successful handoff overlaps at the fish. Source lines are drawn behind faces at the spring. Fish is palm-sized and transparent, with a silver body line; no fish follows the children on the last bridge page.

0158: moved the direction sign away from the girl’s face and planted the fat bird’s feet on her shoe. Whole book is shown only outside the book world; fox travels alone on p11. The reset removes the first purple tail mark; the later mark persists. On final tucked-tail poses removed the duplicate rear purple patch and bell, brought the single purple tip under the navy scarf and left one visible bell. Book corner and fox paw are separate after refusal; whale-bone-shaped white flower branches are plants, not animal remains.

0159: removed duplicate on-board Salt when it is off-board. Lowered and scaled the shoulder knight clear of the girl’s face; lowered the bag-held knight below her chin. Re-drew the moving arm over the board to remove the floating hand. Captured Salt and the single chessbag rest on the table outside the board during the loss and handshake; neither re-enters before review. The handshake meets one of eight tentacles. The illustrated move chain uses f3-d4-b5 knight moves, a8-a7 rook and a6-b5 bishop capture; p16 restores all 32 pieces to the initial position. Boards are stylized, readable grids and do not reconstruct every move of a complete game.

0160: preserved four fixed platforms with two road states and separate held/tied/free brake modes. Crow perches on fence, stands on reachable platforms, and its beak now meets the mailbox hat; it never flies through the roof. Map sheets sit on a table; second comparison crow points toward them. Return cloth bag is supported at the platform edge and shows an envelope. Role-switched rope reaches the crow’s wing. Final child and crow sit/stand behind the eight pots; seven new sprouts, two blue plant markers, snail, white pebble and blank last notebook page are retained. Mailbox is absent from the home ending.
visualReview.limits: Simplified original vector picture-book illustrations. Review covers scene continuity, visible anatomy, relevant props, supported placement and overlaps. Chess grids show representative positions and the specified short move chain, not a full recorded game. This review does not certify bitmap painting, audio quality, browser layout, deployment or child-user testing.
